en.t: The original text was one and a half pages plus three lines.

units.source_text: 誊写时，将对话改行，抄下来成了四页零四行。

en.t: When I copied it out, I started a new line for each piece of dialogue, and the copy came to four pages plus four lines.

units.source_text: 只有一点是千真万确的，那就是应该接在我二十七岁时发表的那部分日记之后。

en.t: Only one thing is absolutely certain: it should follow the part of the diary that I published when I was twenty-seven.

units.source_text: 五月十五日，美代因事回家，由阿常婆来替代。

en.t: On May 15, Miyo went home on some business, and old Mrs. Atsune came in her place.

units.source_text: 翌日，即十六日，《十六岁的日记》的记录就中断了。

en.t: The next day, the sixteenth, the entries in Diary at Sixteen broke off.

units.source_text: 在这里抄录下来的，是那之后美代又到我家里来的当天记下来的。

en.t: What is copied here was written down on the day after that when Miyo came to my house again.
